name: ASTRA MILITARUM: SENTINEL
description: Armoured Sentinels are modified with extra protective panelling, making them superb front-line hunters. Carrying deadly heavy weapons into war zones too dense for battle tanks, these mobile hunter-killers excel in destroying vehicles, fortified bunkers, and xenos monstrosities. </br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds one Armoured Sentinel, a light walker toting heavy firepower on a sturdy frame for your Astra Militarum or Genestealer Cults armies in games of Warhammer 40,000.</br></br>The Sentinel can be armed with your choice of autocannon, heavy flamer, lascannon, missile launcher, multi-laser, or plasma cannon on its right side hardpoint, meaning that this flexible walker can be used in any battlefield role. There’s also an optional posable Sentinel chainsaw on its left side hardpoint for more melee punch, and an optional hunter-killer missile for even more firepower. You'll find a variety of cosmetic options, including a searchlight and smoke launchers, stowage and spare equipment racks, and extra fuel canisters.</br></br>This miniature can alternatively be built as a Scout Sentinel with an open cockpit, which trades durability for extra speed in war zones where mobility is essential.</br></br>This kit is supplied with 1x Astra Militarum Vehicle Transfer Sheet, containing 475 high-quality waterslide transfers to decorate your miniatures. These include heraldry for regiments from Cadia, Catachan, Valhalla, Vostroya, Mordian, Tallarn, Krieg, and Tanith, along with squad markings, numerals, and more.</br></br>This kit comprises 91 plastic components and 1x Citadel 80mm Round Base. This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
